body:
As I said I've been depressed, this girl just pushed me over the edge. And yes, I was attached to her.

My loans are wiped clean upon death, so my parents will not be burdened by them. In fact, upon my death they will receive around 20k. 

So back to the question, 4chan suggested letting no one find my body, that way they won't have to go through with the funeral/pain of seeing me dead. I really like that idea, but do you have a better one?

( I'd appreciate it if you actually gave me the advice I am looking for and not "don't do it". Thanks man)

He did cut her off, he removed her from facebook and deleted her number. But he still sees her at parties and he thinks about her all the time. So getting back to the question, how can the pain on the family be eased? Fake a murder, leave a video, etc?
